cards.title: filter() keeps some items
cards.body: `nums.filter(x => x > 10)` makes a new array with only the items where the test is true.

hi.title: filter() kuch items rakhta hai
hi.body: `nums.filter(x => x > 10)` ek naya array banata hai jismein sirf woh items hain jinke liye test true hai.

cards.title: Arrow functions
cards.body: `x => x > 10` is a short function: it takes `x` and gives back `x > 10`.
cards.code:
const isBig = x => x > 10;
console.log(isBig(15), isBig(3));

hi.title: Arrow functions
hi.body: `x => x > 10` ek chhota function hai: yeh `x` leta hai aur `x > 10` wapas deta hai.

cards.title: join() makes text
cards.body: `join(" ")` glues an array's items into one string, with the separator between them.

hi.title: join() text banata hai
hi.body: `join(" ")` array ke items ko ek string mein jodta hai, beech mein separator ke saath.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should print only the numbers over 10, `12 20`, but prints `false true false true`. Tap the bug.

bug.fix: `map` turns every item into the answer of its test. To keep only some items, use `filter`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse sirf 10 se bade numbers, `12 20`, print karne chahiye, par yeh `false true false true` print karta hai. Bug par tap karo.
hi.fix: `map` har item ko uske test ke jawab mein badal deta hai. Sirf kuch items rakhne hon toh `filter` use karo.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: `x % 2 === 1` is true for odd numbers, so only 1 and 3 are kept.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: `x % 2 === 1` odd numbers ke liye true hai, isliye sirf 1 aur 3 rakhe jaate hain.

exercise.prompt: Read whole numbers on one line and print only the even ones, in the same order, separated by spaces. If there are none, print an empty line.
exercise.promptHi: Ek line mein whole numbers padho aur sirf even waale print karo, usi order mein, spaces se alag. Agar ek bhi nahi hai, toh khaali line print karo.
exercise.starterCode:
const nums = prompt().split(" ").map(Number);
// keep the even numbers and print them
